name: Warrior of the Holy Light
summary: A spell-less Paladin who converts lay on hands into an expanding nimbus of protection, healing, energy resistance, and holy radiance.

features.name: Power of Faith
features.summary: Gain an extra lay on hands use and spend one use to create a 30-foot, 1-minute nimbus granting allies +1 morale AC, attacks, damage, and fear saves.
features.scaling: one additional lay on hands use every 4 levels

features.name: Power of Faith (Restoration)
features.summary: The nimbus heals 1d4 ability damage from each ally once per day.

features.name: Power of Faith (Daylight)
features.summary: The nimbus functions as daylight and grants resistance 10 against one selected energy type.

features.name: Power of Faith (Fortification)
features.summary: The nimbus gives allies a 25% chance to negate critical hits.

features.name: Power of Faith (Perfect Nimbus)
features.summary: The nimbus expands to 60 feet and improves its morale bonus, restoration, energy resistance, and critical-hit protection.

features.name: Shining Light
features.summary: Burst holy light in 30 feet to damage and blind evil creatures while healing and blessing good creatures.
